reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the front, and I'd scan it before ordering to check the named ISO 17025 lab and the heavy metals results. If the report is real and matches the lot, I'd try one box of the bisglycinate, but only one, since it has no reviews and no NSF or USP seal.
objection: Zero reviews and no NSF or USP certification. A lab report the brand picked itself isn't the same as a third-party certification, and $1 a day is more than I pay per serving for my current magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews, or an NSF or USP certification, would move me from trying one box to switching my Subscribe & Save over.
